msgs.txt: Like most other apps, set up a subscription instead of making people reload every time to play. Or even just daily amounts of free credits, but a subscription would be constant money instead coming in. Just have like 2 or so models be free to use with set subscription and with every level of it add more models to be able to use.

Hi 유저, this is Sion from the Frontia team  Thank you so much for the suggestion!

First, about daily free credits: there's already a way to get free Stars every day. Tap the Star icon at the top right of Home and open the Free Star tab. You'll get 2 daily missions there, and they reset every day at 6 AM your local time. You can claim the rewards in the app.

As for a subscription, I think what you're really after is being able to enjoy your stories every day without worrying about reloading Stars each time you play. We completely understand that, and we're exploring different ways to make playing feel lighter and more comfortable. If you'd like to tell us roughly how often you play and which AI models you use most, even a short answer would really help us understand what players like you need.

We'll pass your idea on to the team, and we'll keep listening to your voice as we build Frontia together 

Thank you.
Sion

I play long running stories, honestly I have been playing this one hogwarts one that follows the exact events of the first book and it is hard to get through even three in rp days without having to reload. Spent ten dollars just to play for an extended time on my day off.
